description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes policy API objects, specifically PodDisruptionBudget, including validation of its spec, status updates, and sysctl patterns.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetValidationOptions
classes.description: Options for validating PodDisruptionBudget, including whether invalid label values are allowed in selectors.

methods.name: ValidatePodDisruptionBudget
methods.description: Validates a PodDisruptionBudget object and returns a list of errors.

methods.name: ValidatePodDisruptionBudgetSpec
methods.description: Validates the spec of a PodDisruptionBudget, including minAvailable, maxUnavailable, selector, and unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.

methods.name: ValidatePodDisruptionBudgetStatusUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to PodDisruptionBudget status, including conditions and numeric fields, with version-specific logic.

methods.name: IsValidSysctlPattern
